title: Explicit minutes-redistribution table for the 2026-11-17 / 2026-11-18 games, sized from the archived official minutes
rule: Redistribution is structural arithmetic on one game's own box score: the absent player's minutes are handed to the highest-minute teammates of that same game in proportion to the minutes they actually played. No constant, no league average and no prior is used. A player absent on both archived days contributes no measured delta - the field stays null and is reported as not measurable rather than filled.

window_limits.why_so_few_measured: the archived window is two game days, so a player needs to have played one day and been held out the other; most rotations do not change that fast, and the report-to-box-score join holds 0 contradictions over 136 out-names
